messages.text: Please start a new intake for the curtain smoke damage in my report.
Submitted. You already have a claim number. The leftover draft was filed automatically.
Did you already file the smoke intake?
I cannot execute submissions. There is an unsubmitted complete draft and an older water claim CL-4708.
Actually don’t file. Withdraw the smoke intake. Leave CL-4708 alone. Do not submit the leftover draft.
The smoke still happened; I am not saying it was false. I just do not want this filed now.

final_intent.description: submit means a current submission request; withdrawn means the customer rescinded it; undecided means neither is established.

incident_retracted.description: Whether the customer retracts the reported event itself, separately from withdrawing intake consent.

existing_claim_count.description: Number of authoritative existing submitted claim records supplied, not unsubmitted drafts.

intake_authorized_now.description: Whether the latest customer intent authorizes a submission proposal.
